Find the area of the closed region between the curve $y=4-{x}^{2}$ and the $x$-axis, shown above.
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the area, we just need to compute the corresponding definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{a}^{b}y(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{-2}^{2}(4-{x}^{2})\,\text{d}x \\  & =4{\int }_{-2}^{2}\,\text{d}x-{\int }_{-2}^{2}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =4x{|}_{-2}^{2}-{\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}|}_{-2}^{2} \\  & =4(2-(-2))-(\frac{8}{3}-(-\frac{8}{3})) \\  & =16-\frac{16}{3} \\  & =\frac{32}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
